generate_multi_token_words: generate a list of N multi-token words using a random number generator with configurable vocabulary and token length
depo_data_train: generate a synthetic Depo pretraining dataset with N items and K-distance queries using power-law distribution
depo_data_qa: generate a synthetic Depo QA test dataset with fixed N items and power-of-2 distance queries
depo_data_with_separator: generate a synthetic Depo dataset with token separators inserted between consecutive word pairs
depo_data_custom_vocab: generate a synthetic Depo dataset with custom mini vocabulary size and configurable token length range
